zh.name: 波涛夫人
zh.desc:
大海的女儿们，被「毁灭」的罪孽蚀尽灵肉，只余空荡扭曲的形骸，为将临的黑日起舞颂唱。
残有的黑潮自往世流淌，落入此世浪涛——
美艳动人的波涛啊，你为君王饮尽灾殃，酒痕染花碎珍珠点缀的妆——
你醉倒在迷狂的屠场，在血与蜜酿的坟场，引歌为自己号丧。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体及其相邻目标造成少量冰属性伤害。
对我方全体造成少量冰属性伤害，并大概率降低目标的防御力和全属性抗性。
进入【共舞的渴望】状态，每次行动时施放【波涛与你相拥】。若未处于【<u>在毁灭中狂欢</u>】状态，则使<u>能够进入【在毁灭中狂欢】状态的敌方单位</u>进入【<u>在毁灭中狂欢</u>】状态，使其受到的部分伤害以持续伤害形式在一定回合内扣除。\n行动序列上出现【在毁灭中狂欢】倒计时，倒计时回合开始时所有敌方单位解除【<u>在毁灭中狂欢</u>】状态。

405301001.name: 在毁灭中狂欢
405301001.desc: 触发行动提前的受击次数降低，受到伤害或施放特定技能造成伤害时，使部分伤害以【黑潮热】形式在一定回合内扣除。【在毁灭中狂欢】倒计时回合开始时所有敌方单位解除【在毁灭中狂欢】状态。

405301003.name: 能够进入【在毁灭中狂欢】状态的敌方单位
405301003.desc: 能够进入【在毁灭中狂欢】状态的敌方单位：浪花侍女、波涛夫人、泡影稚子、飓风大母。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成少量冰属性伤害，处于【<u>在毁灭中狂欢</u>】状态时，对受到攻击的我方目标施加【<u>黑潮热</u>】，使造成的部分伤害以持续伤害形式在一定回合内扣除。

405301001.name: 在毁灭中狂欢
405301001.desc: 触发行动提前的受击次数降低，受到伤害或施放特定技能造成伤害时，使部分伤害以【黑潮热】形式在一定回合内扣除。【在毁灭中狂欢】倒计时回合开始时所有敌方单位解除【在毁灭中狂欢】状态。

405301002.name: 黑潮热
405301002.desc: 【黑潮热】属于持续伤害类负面状态，持续伤害来源于目标受到伤害的一部分，叠加时刷新【黑潮热】的持续回合。【黑潮热】状态下，目标每回合开始时受到风化、灼烧、触电、裂伤持续伤害。敌方的【黑潮热】状态在【在毁灭中狂欢】状态结束时立即解除，我方的【黑潮热】状态在自身生命值回复到上限时立即解除，免受该持续伤害。

skill_list.skill_desc: 受到一定次数的普攻、战技、终结技或忆灵技攻击后行动提前，处于【<u>在毁灭中狂欢</u>】状态时，触发行动提前的受击次数降低。

405301001.name: 在毁灭中狂欢
405301001.desc: 触发行动提前的受击次数降低，受到伤害或施放特定技能造成伤害时，使部分伤害以【黑潮热】形式在一定回合内扣除。【在毁灭中狂欢】倒计时回合开始时所有敌方单位解除【在毁灭中狂欢】状态。

en.name: Lady of Crashing Waves
en.desc:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Enchanting waves, you drank calamity for your sovereign, and your visage is adorned with wine-stained petals and shattered pearls—
You lie drunken in the frenzied abattoir, and in this grave of blood and honeyed ruin, you sing your elegy into the void.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated target and their adjacent targets.
Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets and has a high chance to decrease the targets' DEF and All-Type RES.

Enters "Yearning for a Shared Dance" state. Uses "Embrace From the Waves" in every action. If not in "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, <u>friendly units that can enter the "Revel in Destruction" state</u> will enter the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state. This causes some DMG taken to be received in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.\nA "Revel in Destruction" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown turn begins, all friendly units will have their "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state dispelled.

405301001.name: Revel in Destruction
405301001.desc: Number of hits to advance action decreases. When taking DMG or using certain abilities to deal DMG, some DMG will be taken in the form of "Black Tide Fever" over a specific number of turns. When the "Revel in Destruction" countdown's turn begins, all enemy units will have their "Revel in Destruction" state dispelled.

405301003.name: Enemy units that can enter "Revel in Destruction" state
405301003.desc: Enemy units that can enter "Revel in Destruction" state: Servant of Tides, Lady of Crashing Waves, Mirage Fizzle Kid, Cyclonic Swarm Mother.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, inflicts "<u>Black Tide Fever</u>" on the targets attacked, causing some DMG dealt to be taken in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.

405301001.name: Revel in Destruction
405301001.desc: Number of hits to advance action decreases. When taking DMG or using certain abilities to deal DMG, some DMG will be taken in the form of "Black Tide Fever" over a specific number of turns. When the "Revel in Destruction" countdown's turn begins, all enemy units will have their "Revel in Destruction" state dispelled.

405301002.name: Black Tide Fever
405301002.desc: "Black Tide Fever" is a type of DoT debuff. The DoT originates from a part of the DMG that the target takes. When stacked, it resets the duration of "Black Tide Fever." In "Black Tide Fever," targets receive Wind Shear, Burn, Shock, and Bleed DoT at the start of their turns. The enemies' "Black Tide Fever" is immediately dispelled when the "Revel in Destruction" state ends. Allies' "Black Tide Fever" is immediately dispelled when their HP is fully restored. The targets will not take the DoT damage after this state is dispelled.

skill_list.skill_desc: Advances action after taking a certain number of attacks from Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, or Memosprite Skill. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, decreases the number of attacks required to advance action.

405301001.name: Revel in Destruction
405301001.desc: Number of hits to advance action decreases. When taking DMG or using certain abilities to deal DMG, some DMG will be taken in the form of "Black Tide Fever" over a specific number of turns. When the "Revel in Destruction" countdown's turn begins, all enemy units will have their "Revel in Destruction" state dispelled.
